about: The migrator failed partway after its retries, with a valid record of three units. u1 is whole (its copy is in idea-tobias). u2 is a split and partly written: its idea-mara copy is there, its idea-tobias copy isn't. u3 is not started: it would have created Ideas/idea-lamp.md, which doesn't exist. `record --failed` sends u1 on: verify-b1-r0.json holds u1 only, and the run is at verifying with fixing [u1]. u2's idea-mara copy is removed, so idea-mara is back to its start. u2 and u3 join the unit index as undone, in record order. u2's unwritten copy and u3's lines aren't undo misses: they were never written.
spec: spec-run-manager.md 04 item 22 (When a part fails, first bullet)
readings: A partly written or not-started unit's unwritten lines are not undo misses (CONTRACT.md 5.3 item 10 names misses only for lines the writer changed; spec-migration-verifier.md 07 item 3 says a not-started unit has nothing to remove).
Units undone in one step join the unit index in record order.
